test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

He did not **knew **the answer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**knew**."
 
• The verb "**knew**" is in the past tense, but the auxiliary verb "**did**" is used in the sentence, which requires the base form of the verb.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**did not know**."
 
• Thus, the error lies in the bold part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He did not know the answer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Did + base verb:** Whenever "did" is used in a sentence, it is always followed by the base form of the verb (e.g., know, eat, go).
 
• **Common mistake:** Confusion arises when learners mistakenly use the past tense after "did."
 
• **Example for clarity:** "She did not dance" is correct, while "She did not danced" is incorrect.
